import json,os
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
TZ=timezone(timedelta(hours=8))
day='2026-10-31'
paths=[
 '/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/data/task_provenance.jsonl',
 os.path.expanduser('~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl'),
 '/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/incoming/worker_ant_agent_bus_inbox.jsonl',
]
for p in paths:
  print('===',p,'exists',os.path.exists(p))
  if not os.path.exists(p):
    continue
  n=0
  with open(p,'r',errors='replace') as f:
    for line in f:
      line=line.strip()
      if not line: continue
      try: o=json.loads(line)
      except: continue
      # find time fields
      ts=o.get('ts') or o.get('created_at') or o.get('time') or o.get('received_at') or ''
      s=str(ts)
      if day in s or (isinstance(ts,(int,float)) and datetime.fromtimestamp(ts/1000 if ts>1e12 else ts, TZ).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')==day):
        n+=1
        src=o.get('source') or o.get('from') or o.get('kind') or ''
        text=(o.get('text') or o.get('summary') or o.get('prompt') or o.get('payload') or '')
        if isinstance(text,dict): text=str(text)[:200]
        else: text=str(text)[:200].replace('\n',' ')
        print(f'  {s[:19]} | {src} | bus={o.get("bus_id") or o.get("id")} | {text}')
  print('  count',n)
PY
